items.heading: Momos
details: Key ingredients: flour, minced meat or vegetables, ginger, garlic, onion
Fill small dough wrappers with a seasoned minced meat or vegetable mixture.
Pleat and seal each dumpling by hand.
Steam in a stacked steamer until cooked through.
Serve hot with a spicy tomato-sesame dipping sauce.

items.heading: Dal Bhat
details: Key ingredients: lentils, rice, seasonal vegetable curry, pickle
Cook a pot of yellow lentils seasoned with turmeric, garlic and cumin.
Steam rice separately until fluffy.
Prepare a simple seasonal vegetable curry as a side.
Serve the lentils, rice, vegetable curry and pickle together as a full plate.

items.heading: Sel Roti
details: Key ingredients: rice flour, sugar, milk, cardamom, ghee
Blend soaked rice into a thick batter with sugar, milk and cardamom.
Rest the batter for a few hours.
Pipe rings of batter directly into hot oil.
Fry until golden brown and crisp, then drain and cool.

items.heading: Momo
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt, filling of vegetables or meat, aromatics and dipping sauce.
Make a pliable dough, roll thin, fill and seal.
Steam or boil until cooked; serve with a seasoned sauce.

items.heading: Thukpa
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
